name: command-guard
description: Holds risky Bash commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, force push, DROP TABLE ...), shows exactly what they would destroy, and asks first. A safety net, not a permission system.

maxListed.title: Rows to list
maxListed.description: Most files, commits or paths listed in the confirmation (the rest is counted as +N more).

askFrom.title: Ask from risk level
askFrom.description: The lowest risk level that opens the dialog. medium (default): low-risk commands run without a dialog. high: only high and unknown. low: ask about everything. A command that could not be checked (unknown) always asks.

extraPatterns.title: Extra patterns
extraPatterns.description: Regular expressions; a Bash command matching any of them is held too (nothing is measured for these).
